title: GregoireF/homebrew-tap tools.yml
description: The tools the tap serves. lib/tap/config.rb applies the same rules; test/schema_test.rb keeps both in step.

repo.description: GitHub repository that publishes the releases.

desc.description: Homebrew description: at most 80 characters, no final period, no leading article, does not start with the tool's name.

test.description: Arguments that make the first binary print its version.

verify.description: attestation: every archive needs a SLSA provenance from a workflow of repo. checksum: SHA-256 only.

checksums.description: Checksums file attached to each release.

assets.description: Archive name per platform; {version} is the version without v.

caveats.description: Text Homebrew and Scoop print after the install.

completions.description: Arguments that make the first binary print a completion script; the shell's name is appended.

pin.description: Serve exactly this release instead of the latest (written by bin/tap rollback; quote it).

formula.description: Homebrew formula name when the tool's name is taken in homebrew-core (Formula/<formula>.rb).

conflicts.description: Formulae that install the same binaries (conflicts_with in the formula).

winget.description: WinGet package identifier (Publisher.Name); needs the top-level publisher.
